tasks.short: Instruct students with disabilities in academic subjects

steps.what: Read the actual learning objective and chosen phonetics or multisensory activity guidance in {DOCS}.
Instruct students with disabilities in academic subjects using actual phonetics, multisensory learning and repetition.
Check actual understanding and vary prompts, sensory supports and repetition to meet individual needs.

tasks.design: Keep direct academic instruction human and use the already selected activity guidance in {DOCS}. Test native access first; where that guidance is already directly available, neither a template nor generated dialogue removes the teacher's actual delivery or understanding checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teacher must react to actual learning, not merely present information.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability in this design replaces direct academic support.
tasks.still_hard: Students can echo an answer without understanding its meaning.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the difference and choose a more useful prompt.
tasks.altitude: No change in instructional time or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Direct instructional delivery and individual understanding checks remain situated human work.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual academic teaching encounter using an existing activity, not a fresh lesson-writing exercise for every interaction. No task-specific written output is established here: do not invent a trailing progress record or assume automatic capture. Any actual required pupil-record entry needs its own destination/time analysis and earns no benefit here.

The existing planning process produces the objective and activity guidance; s1 counts reading it and confirming applicability. Native direct access is already in place in this case. S2-s3 produce actual teaching and checking, not a structured machine input.
Native material access and templates were considered; they remove no further work in this encounter. No new software or record process means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether actual instruction includes a separate required record entry
research_questions: Is any actual repeated record transfer present beyond direct teaching and the existing activity card?

already_counted.description: Read guidance, instruct, check understanding and adjust support

incremental.description: No new system or workflow; no additional upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 less0 incremental=0 net. Native lookup is already direct and no actual report/send or repeated document production is established for this encounter. No physical or relational teaching time is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement disability support strategies

steps.what: Read actual learning needs, current support evidence and relevant approved strategy guidance.
Discuss actual barriers with relevant support staff and select suitable strategies using professional judgement.
Write the selected strategy's practical activity sequence in the existing support plan in {DOCS}.

loop.purpose: Draft a practical sequence for an already selected strategy
loop.input: Actual approved guidance and teacher-authored nonidentifying constraints
loop.output: Draft activity sequence with explicit source references
loop.check: Teacher checks wording before actual trial in retained s3 time and checks suitability and response in s4-s5
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsafe action, unsupported technique or unmet constraint returns to manual writing within retained work
loop.why_not_simpler: Use an existing activity sequence unchanged where it fits; varied functional constraints require adapted wording rather than a fixed field fill.

steps.what: Implement the teacher-checked strategy with actual students, observing access and participation.
inputs: Draft practical strategy sequence checked in s3

steps.what: Evaluate actual response and revise the existing support strategy wording where needed.
Save the ordinary authored strategy in the existing support plan.

tasks.design: Reuse existing approved sequences in {DOCS} first; where actual adaptation is necessary, a bounded model drafts the teacher-selected strategy's activity wording. The teacher supplies constraints, checks before use, implements the activity and evaluates the actual response; no model chooses a disability strategy or profiles a pupil.
tasks.previous_blocker: Individual access constraints make reusable sequences incomplete.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded source-based drafting can adapt wording while leaving the actual strategy choice human.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible sequence may be impractical or ineffective for a particular student.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and test support using knowledge of the student, not a diagnosis label.

ambition.what: Prepare an alternative activity sequence for one selected strategy when a physical-access barrier blocks the original.

tasks.altitude: Less initial sequence typing; all strategy selection, trial and response interpretation remain with the teacher.

reach.task: Document an alternative implementation of an approved strategy
reach.learn: Access testing and source-bound activity design

evidence.claim: Source-bound drafting may reduce activity-sequence wording while strategy choice and actual trial remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes a real written support strategy used by teaching/support staff and its implementation, not a new strategy register for every classroom interaction. No saving is borrowed from academic instruction or curriculum modification tasks.

Actual pupil needs are read in s1 from the pupil-record category of {OTHER}. Teacher captures functional constraints and selects the strategy in s2, without sending personal identifiers to the draft service. Existing approved guidance has an actual owner and version; missing guidance or constraints remain manual work in s1-s3.

Test native approved sequences first. Only s3 initial wording loses6.25 provisional hours;18.75 remain for substantive writing, checks before trial and manual fallback. S4-s5 retain all actual trial, evaluation and failed-draft repair. No added self-approval or ordinary-save saving.
research_questions: Does the draft retain the selected strategy rather than substitute a plausible but unsupported intervention?

already_counted.description: Evidence, constraint capture, human strategy selection, drafting checks, trial, evaluation, correction and save

incremental.description: Maintain source-bound draft instructions and inspect failed activity sequences

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R93.75 gives6.25 gross less1 upkeep=5.25 net; high rounded down5.2. Low0 retains all sequence writing for highly individual access needs where draft adaptation is unusable and avoids deployment/upkeep. Trial and selection are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach socially acceptable behavior using positive reinforcement

steps.what: Check the actual agreed behavior-support approach and immediate classroom context.
Teach socially acceptable behavior through actual modeling, practice and positive reinforcement.
outputs: Delivered social behavior teaching and reinforcement

steps.what: Judge actual response and adjust reinforcement, prompts and support without inferring emotions automatically.
inputs: Delivered social behavior teaching and reinforcement

tasks.design: Keep actual behavior teaching and reinforcement human, using the existing agreed guidance in {DOCS}. Test native retrieval first; when the guidance is already directly available, a new template or behavioral scoring tool removes no established work from this encounter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Timing, trust and the meaning of the actual response determine effective reinforcement.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability in this design reduces that direct work.
tasks.still_hard: The same reward or prompt can have different effects in different situations.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to the actual student and relationship rather than a proxy score.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in task time or behavior-support authority.

evidence.claim: Direct modeling and reinforcement remain situated teaching work; document templates alone do not deliver it.

assumptions: Boundary is actual teaching of social behavior, not writing a new behavior plan. No separate per-interaction record, point award, token register or family message is established by this task; none is invented to create saving. If actual individualized support requires a written tally, analyse its real capture/destination separately before changing it; no saving is claimed for it here.

Existing agreed guidance is already produced during actual support planning. S1 counts checking its content and immediate applicability, with native direct access already available. S2-s3 are human interaction and judgement, not a new structured data feed.
Native retrieval and reusable materials were considered; no additional work disappears in this case. No new system, record or model means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether a real existing tally is part of the actual support approach
research_questions: Is there an actual repeated record operation within this teaching encounter rather than an assumed one?

already_counted.description: Actual guidance/context, modeling, reinforcement and response-based adjustments

incremental.description: No new process; no additional ongoing work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 with0 upkeep gives0 net. Source checking is separated and native access tested; there is no established additional record or send to automate. No live reinforcement or judgement time is cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify the elementary curriculum for disability access

steps.what: Review the actual elementary curriculum objectives and students' existing functional access requirements.
outputs: Selected source objectives and access constraints

steps.what: Decide curriculum modifications, retained learning objectives and nonidentifying constraints for adaptation.
inputs: Selected source objectives and access constraints
outputs: Teacher-decided curriculum changes and drafting brief

steps.what: Assemble the selected objective codes, original references and adaptation headings into the curriculum document.
inputs: Teacher-decided curriculum changes and drafting brief
Selected source objectives and access constraints

steps.what: Write modified curriculum passages and activities to implement the teacher's actual choices.
inputs: Teacher-decided curriculum changes and drafting brief

loop.purpose: Draft modified passages from supplied curriculum and teacher decisions
loop.input: Fixed source excerpts, objective codes and nonidentifying adaptation brief
loop.output: Draft adapted passages and activities linked to source objectives
loop.check: Teacher verifies objective preservation, instructional meaning and actual access in s5
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; invented objective, unsuitable activity or unworkable access returns to manual writing within retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: Native field assembly covers s3, but varied text changes under functional constraints require bounded language drafting.

steps.what: Check and repair the adapted curriculum for objective coverage, meaning and actual access needs.
inputs: Selected source objectives and access constraints

steps.what: Save the ordinary authored curriculum adaptation in the existing teaching file.

tasks.design: Use native fields in {DOCS} for exact objective references and headings before a bounded model drafts teacher-selected curriculum changes. The teacher supplies the functional brief, verifies every modification and retains all educational decisions; no pupil assessment or diagnosis is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated objective/reference assembly and varied prose adaptation are mixed with curriculum judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fields remove literal assembly; bounded rewriting can offer draft wording under actual teacher constraints.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent rewrite may remove the skill being taught or fail the real access requirement.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve a meaningful learning challenge while changing how the student can engage with it.

ambition.what: Compare two access routes to the same elementary curriculum objective without changing the objective.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated reference copying and first-draft wording; more attention to educational meaning and access, with unchanged decision rights.

reach.task: Compare access routes to one curriculum objective
reach.learn: Objective alignment and real accessibility checks

evidence.claim: Native objective assembly and bounded source-based drafting can assist curriculum modification while teachers retain educational decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual written curriculum adaptation, distinct from strategy-plan sequences and live teaching. No new pupil-progress register is added. Shares are provisional work estimates.

Curriculum owners produce objective ids, source passages, version and references in ordinary curriculum work. Teacher source selection and actual functional-constraint capture are counted in s1-s2. No personal identifiers or diagnosis documents enter the drafting brief; s4-s5 retain missing fields, draft corrections and manual repair of failed native assembly.

Test native objective fields first. S3 removes only10 hours of actual repeated source/reference assembly. S4 removes7.5 first-wording hours while17.5 remain for case-specific writing and checking, plus all19 final checks. Ordinary saving remains1 fully retained and ungated; existing automatic assembly earns no new benefit.
unknowns: Native curriculum field and drafting permissions
research_questions: Can source objective codes survive both native assembly and adapted prose without changing the intended skill?

already_counted.description: Source and access review, teacher changes/brief, writing correction, semantic/access checks, failed-assembly repair and save

incremental.description: Maintain objective mappings and inspect adapted-text failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5 gives17.5 gross less2 upkeep=15.5 net. Low8 retains all25 wording hours when highly individual communication/access changes defeat the draft, while exact objective/reference assembly still removes10 less2 upkeep. Incompatible source metadata would retain that assembly too and needs a different case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use source-bound drafting and exact curriculum assembly for actual document work while retaining academic teaching, behavior support and disability-strategy judgement.
reach: Compare objective-preserving access variants with an instructional coordinator
role.ambitious_version: A teacher able to compare alternative access routes while preserving the actual curriculum objective and personal responsibility for instruction.
